Hi Reviewers,
Thank you for your feedbacks. you can access all the Evidences via this Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1zPea5TmQzpeF8t_8cPXyw7BQtbMK0OPN/view?usp=sharing
The previous reviewer also suggested I paste all Evidence link in the method below:
Milestone: Partnerships and Collaborations
1.List of potential partner organizations and stakeholders, documented partnership
・Goma Hub MoU Document: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1tRrMlN4hagofNSMQKNd1cGOUBOtoeLxH/view
・Remostart MoU Document: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1deTl6jpsmgcRkftH_oFW5yR2AybD1_oC/view
・Adafro Labs MOU Document: https://drive.google.com/file/d/15JtDfrlFqirts0JEchWZqdUvKc0YdpIO/view

2.Agreements or memoranda of understanding, joint initiative proposals
・Catalyst Africa Town Hall partnered with the Accra Resource Centre and the Ghana Cardano Community to implement a joint project aimed at promoting Cardano governance education. A formal Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed between all parties, clearly outlining roles, responsibilities, and collaborative objectives. https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ggRstGagmRBNkEF94a94ZznRHN4YjOZg/view?usp=drive_link

Together, we successfully organized the Cardano Workshops in Ghana, Nigeria, Congo and Uganda, South Africa, which brought together community members, developers, and blockchain enthusiasts to learn, discuss, and engage in decentralized governance on Cardano.
3.Progress and events will be shared on our official Twitter page.
